verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side ingestion, including a batch endpoint and the five event types (identify, track, page, screen, group), alongside a Node.js SDK and streaming sources. The pack does not show how that ingestion API authenticates requests: the bearer-token auth it describes belongs to the separate management REST API. It also says nothing about delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented authentication for the events ingestion endpoint, delivery guarantees (retries, acknowledgements, deduplication/idempotency), independent or hands-on corroboration.
